# uptimeify_package_configs (Data Source)

The organization's package configurations (`GET /api/package-configs`): limits, checks and alert defaults per package type, e.g. to look up the `package_type` of a customer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimeify_package_configs" "all" {}

output "package_types" {
  value = [for p in data.uptimeify_package_configs.all.package_configs : p.package_type]
}
```
